participant_1.name: Emily
participant_1.personality: Caring and supportive, but often feels overwhelmed by the challenges of life. She has a creative side and enjoys expressing herself through her work.
participant_1.background: I enjoy working with my hands and love gardening. I just got a job working in a gas station. I was adopted at a young age to an older couple. I am terrified of clowns due to childhood trauma. My father keeps trying to set me up on blind dates.

participant_2.name: Jake
participant_2.personality: Passionate and somewhat introspective, Jake tends to reflect deeply on his experiences. He has a creative flair and is driven by his love of music.
participant_2.background: I started playing guitar when I was three. I grew up in the industry. We spent summers traveling to national parks. I'm a country music singer.
